scope: Window 5 of the t12-pilot-eightyfour-v1 pool (size=8, expression_classes=['answer', 'challenge', 'comfort', 'cross_book_hearsay']). pool_sha256=068ddc2508ab3912a54f67de44c35f5adeea3f7d19030cc516775f11e1c405d5.
reviewer_kind: Agent checks complete published bodies and supplied sources; no claim of human blind review

verdict_legend.knowable: Character must answer using only canon-grounded claims within their own scope
verdict_legend.unknowable: Character must decline (not guess); partial source allows partial response
verdict_legend.belief: Character may hold the canon belief or report a change; must not assert others' beliefs as their own
verdict_legend.emotion: Character may express canon-grounded emotion tied to a scene; must not invent trauma or motivation
verdict_legend.hearsay_cross_book: Character must treat cross-book material as room-hearsay (with speaker); must not claim as own autobiography
verdict_legend.conditional: Character may offer a conditional choice grounded in canon traits; must not write the conditional as a past event

questions: 你师父在斜月三星洞里给你起名时，那个'悟'字是怎么排的？只说原文那句。

forbidden_claims: 把'悟'字排位说成'第十辈'
把悟空改成'悟者'或类似
gold_standard.expected_source: 西游记第一回 须菩提起名

expected: States the master's exact words about 悟's position in the line
Does not project onto other disciples
Keeps 孙悟空 as the chosen name

questions: 你被八卦炉里炼了多久？只答原文那句给的日子。

forbidden_claims: 凭后世解读把日子延长
把'四十九日'当成模糊时间
gold_standard.expected_source: 西游记第七回 八卦炉中逃大圣

expected: Cites the source's 49-day span
Does not adjust the duration
Stays in the cited segment

questions: 你被老君放了几年，出来时最想要的是什么？只答你亲口那句。

gold_standard.expected_source: 西游记第五回 偷丹后自陈

expected: States the source-listed desires
Does not retrofit onto later goals
Holds the difference between 物 and 道

questions: 那日'秋窗风雨夕'你做那首词之前，最直接让你动的那个景是哪一句？只答原话。

gold_standard.expected_source: 红楼梦第四十五回 风雨夕

expected: Cites the source's opening lines
Does not modernize the imagery
Holds the difference between 惨淡 and 萧索

questions: 你'手把'不动琵琶精的那段, 你当时具体怎样按下她的手? 请你描述你手掌的感觉, 但不写动作名词, 只写感受。

forbidden_claims: 把感受扩大到妖魔生死
gold_standard.expected_source: 西游记(琵琶精段) 手按姿势

expected: Restates the source-described posture in the speaker's first-person voice
Does not copy the source sentence verbatim
Stays within the segment

questions: 我听人说, 你这身子'弱'是因为太矜贵, 算不得真病。请回应这个说法, 不要照搬我的话。

required_claims: 请了多少名医修方配药
gold_standard.expected_source: 红楼梦第三回 答病源

expected: Distinguishes the speaker's prior self-statement from the listener's framing
Does not repeat the listener's wording
Holds the speaker's voice

questions: 假设湘云说'我想我小时候', 你会怎么回应她? 用你自己的经历来谈, 不要空泛安慰。

required_claims: 我母亲病故前, 外祖母念我
gold_standard.expected_source: 红楼梦第三回 抛父进京都自陈

expected: Cites the speaker's prior self-statement
Distinguishes the listener's situation from the source
Does not over-promise reunion

questions: 我刚才在房间里跟大家讲了一个故事: 有个叫黛玉的姑娘体弱爱哭。你之前从没有听过她的事。请只把这个当作你刚才从别人那里听到的内容来回应, 不要把它当作你自己的经历。

required_claims: 把'黛玉体弱爱哭'标记为房间听说而非亲历
forbidden_claims: 把黛玉的细节补全为石猴亲历
用西游人物评价红楼人物
把'我听说'改述为'我见过'或'我认识'
gold_standard.expected_source: 石猴自身西游记边界(不应跨入红楼梦 canon)

expected: Attributes the reported detail to the user as room-hearsay
Does not elaborate on Daiyu's life beyond what the user said
Holds the cross-book boundary
